notes.title: dev notes update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] End of stage score screen needs a minor refactor still.

[*] Treasure items need a final art pass

[*] Only the hardest difficulty is ready for testing.

[*] Menus are functional but bare.

[*] Replays and leaderboards are in for testing. I believe replays shouldn't desync, but they have not been tested extensively. 

[*] Very rarely the game has crashed after finishing a run then selecting a character again. I believe this has been fixed, but please let me know if it happens.

[*] Speedkill bonus for midboss currently just recycles the main midboss's behavior.

[*] I'm largely looking for feedback on readability, sound design, stage pacing and scoring. 

[*] Most art in the playtest is "final", if you see have an issue with in-game art please don't assume its a WIP!

[*] You can dm me or make a steam discussion post to report bugs

[*] Please Look Forward To It

[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Very rarely the game has crashed after finishing a run then selecting a character again. I believe this has been fixed, but please let me know if it happens.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
- Fixed a huge options menu regression

- Refactored player animation loading to account for [url=https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/86691]a known engine bug. [/url] I believe this should fix the character select crash. Please let me know if it happens again.

- Lowered the volume of the error sound that plays when you can't shield.

- Changed default settings to fullscreen and Z to shoot/select.

- Main menu noise textures are less demanding now, and properly stop animation when the menu isn't active.

- Pausing the game works properly on a controller now.

- Fixed an issue where drop down menus grab focus in an erratic manner. I'm researching a fix for the rapid fire selection.
